answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 12514 Country: India Title: i am a goverment servent having limited source of income i hardly manage to save some amount of money for the welfare of my children as the inflation goes up what is the islamic way to invest my money so that i can get at the end of retirement handsome amount for the welfare of the family. Question: i am a goverment servent having limited source of income i hardly manage to save some amount of money for the welfare of my children as the inflation goes up what is the islamic way to invest my money so that i can get at the end of retirement handsome amount for the welfare of the family. Answer ID: 12514 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1044/802=H/1430) Adopt any form of business, partnership or mudharabah etc which suits you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
